references.text: Basic instructions on bringing a grain offering to the priests, who shall offer it on the altar
The priest shall take a portion of the grain offering and burn it on the altar as a memorial
Instructions on bringing wave offerings with one's own hands and waving them before the Lord
The priest shall wave the grain before the Lord, using the same waving motion as in the jealousy offering
The wave offering is performed by placing the gift on the priest's hands and waving them before the Lord
Earlier in the same chapter, the grain offering for jealousy that the priest must receive is described
The priest brings the woman forward before the Lord with the jealousy offering in her hands
